items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was in the army listening very quietly... listening to Willis Conover the voice of America Jazz hour. ‘Ladies and Gentlemen, tonight we present the new Miles Davis Quintet with George Coleman and Herbie Hancock,’ blah, blah, blah.

ctx.x: George Coleman. I was in the army listening very quietly because it was forbidden to listen to Jazz music, listening to Willis Conover the voice of America Jazz hour. ‘Ladies and Gentlemen, tonight we present the new Miles Davis Quintet with George Coleman and Herbie Hancock,’ blah, blah, blah. When I’m hearing that, I’m saying what is the tempo? [Willard laughs] I was used to [imitates rhythm/style] that be-bop type of thing, and I wasn’t used to that.
